answer: Count influence as residual capacity, not as a census of keys. Established roots slowly issue limited endorsements, and an agent's voting weight is the max-flow that can reach it on edge-disjoint paths. A hundred shells hanging from one sponsor still carry only that sponsor's capacity — one pearl on a violet thread cannot swell into a lotus pond. When two keys later share a signer, those incoming edges merge and surplus flow is burned, so cloning never multiplies votes.
